about: Mechanical testing and rheology: clamp, contact, zero, calibrate, move, method, set-temp, start (job), stop, result, analyze, status. Ranges, enums and units come from each contract; method templates are the contracts' reference arguments.

excluded.ta_dma850: dynamic mechanical analyser: its load is part of a temperature programme (thermal_analysis primary); a second class on it would add only the run verbs it already has there.
excluded.ta_tma450: thermomechanical analyser: the probe force is a method setting of a thermal programme (thermal_analysis primary).
excluded.specac_atlasmanual: hydraulic pellet press: its load is applied by hand pump strokes, which the solid_prep class covers (pump, valve, method load=); no specimen response is measured, so the mechanical verbs (contact, zero, analyze) do not apply.

unsupported.analyze: its evaluations need a wear-track profile from a profilometer (analysis.wear_profile) or material constants (analysis.hertz), not the test record; result already reports the friction coefficient

alternatives.clamp: nothing to do: lower the arm with `chemlab run antonpaar_trb contact on`.
alternatives.analyze: use `chemlab run antonpaar_trb result` for the friction coefficient; for contact pressure see `chemlab help antonpaar_trb analysis.hertz`.

move: on the tribometer `move` sets the wear-track radius of the pin on the disk (radius.set)
method: load= sets the dead weight on the arm (normal_load.set) and the drive keys (speed=, freq=, stroke=, amplitude=, drive=) the drive (drive.configure); both only with the arm lifted and the lid open
set-temp: works only with a heating module installed by the lab; the default lab has none (NO_HEATER)

AUTOMATIC_CONTROL_MAX_100HZ.message: in force or strain control {inst} samples at most 100 Hz.
AUTOMATIC_CONTROL_MAX_100HZ.fix: add rate-hz=100 (or lower) to the method.

EXTENSOMETER_REQUIRED.message: strain control on {inst} needs the extensometer, which this fixture does not have.

SOFTWARE_OPTION_REQUIRED.message: without the TRAPEZIUM X software {inst} runs only speed control at up to 10 Hz.

FIXTURE_FORCE_LIMIT.message: the force is above the 5 kN rating of the grips on {inst}.
FIXTURE_FORCE_LIMIT.fix: give load= / stop-force= at or below 5kN.

ZERO_CALIBRATION_SIGNAL.message: the load cell of {inst} reads no force, so there is nothing to calibrate against.
ZERO_CALIBRATION_SIGNAL.fix: calibration needs the reference force applied (the operator's calibration fixture or a loaded specimen at rest); then `calibrate ref=FORCE` with that force.

COMPRESSION_OR_SLACK_UNSUPPORTED.message: {inst} would push the specimen (crosshead below its free length); only tension is modelled.
COMPRESSION_OR_SLACK_UNSUPPORTED.fix: give a position at or above the current specimen length.

calibrate: calibrate ref=FORCE: the load cell reads the reference force applied by the calibration fixture (force.calibrate)
zero: the force zero is taken unloaded (the reading below the zero band) and with no axis moving (UNLOAD_REQUIRED otherwise)
analyze: the tensile evaluation of the last test rows: area= (cross-section) and gauge= (gauge length) are the specimen priors; the template values are the contract reference specimen

calibrate: the empty friction calibration swing (ISO 179-1); it returns job-N; afterwards the operator re-raises the pendulum
analyze: recomputes the absorbed energy from the last swing's angles with the friction torque of the calibration; area= is the remaining cross-section behind the notch

unsupported.set-temp: the FT4 has no temperature control; it tests at room temperature

alternatives.zero: give the offsets: `chemlab run freeman_ft4powder calibrate force-zero=0N torque-zero=0`.

method: the attachment must fit the mode (blade for dynamic; `chemlab call freeman_ft4powder tool.select --tool_type ...` with the door open)
analyze: the flow energy (force and torque work) of one measurement traverse (--index N = cycle)
